articles.titleEn: Hypertension Management and Dietary Salt Reduction
articles.excerptEn: Practical guidance on blood pressure monitoring and dietary lifestyle modifications.
articles.contentEn: Hypertension is often called the silent killer. Regular monitoring and balanced diet are critical.

articles.excerptNe: धेरैजसो ज्वरो आफैं ठीक हुन्छ — तर केही लक्षण देखिए तुरुन्त चिकित्सकीय सल्लाह लिनुपर्छ।
articles.contentNe: ज्वरो संक्रमणको सामान्य प्रतिक्रिया हो। हल्का अवस्थामा आराम, पर्याप्त तरल र निगरानी पर्याप्त हुन्छ। ज्वरो तीन दिनभन्दा बढी रहेमा, धेरै उच्च भएमा, वा सास फेर्न कठिनाई, कडा टाउको दुखाई, अलमल, छालामा दाग वा लगातार वान्ता भएमा चिकित्सकीय सल्लाह लिनुहोस्।
articles.titleEn: When Should You See a Doctor for a Fever?
articles.excerptEn: Most fevers settle on their own — but some signs mean you should seek clinical advice promptly.
articles.contentEn: A fever is a common response to infection. Rest, fluids and monitoring are usually enough for mild cases. Seek medical advice if the fever lasts more than three days, is very high, or is accompanied by breathing difficulty, severe headache, confusion, a rash, or persistent vomiting. Young children, older adults and people with chronic conditions should be reviewed earlier.

articles.excerptNe: हिमोग्लोबिन, श्वेतकोष र प्लेटलेटले तपाईंको स्वास्थ्यको फरक-फरक पक्ष देखाउँछन्।
articles.contentNe: सीबीसीले रक्तका मुख्य अंगहरू मापन गर्छ। हिमोग्लोबिनले अक्सिजन बोक्छ, श्वेतकोषले रोग प्रतिरोधात्मक क्षमतामा सहयोग गर्छ र प्लेटलेटले रक्त जम्न मद्दत गर्छ। नतिजालाई उमेर, लिङ्ग र लक्षणअनुसार व्याख्या गरिन्छ — सामान्य दायराभन्दा बाहिरको एक मान मात्र निदान होइन।
articles.excerptEn: Haemoglobin, white cells and platelets each tell a different part of your health story.
articles.contentEn: A CBC measures the main components of blood. Haemoglobin carries oxygen, white blood cells support immunity, and platelets help clotting. Results are interpreted against age, sex and symptoms — a single value outside the reference range is not automatically a diagnosis. Always review your report with a clinician, especially if you feel unwell.
